title: Saudi FDI inflows surge 33.5% to SR159.1 billion in 2025
summary: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows increased by 33.5 percent to SR159.1 billion in 2025, compared with SR119.2 billion in 2024, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The increase came as the Kingdom’s total FDI stock rose by 8.3 percent to SR1.06 trillion by the end of 2025, while net FDI inflows increased by 1.7 percent to SR81.4 billion, compared with SR80 billion in 2024. Meanwhile, FDI outflows increased by 98.5 percent to SR77.7 billion, up from SR39.2 billion in the previous year. Construction activities recorded the highest contribution to total FDI inflows at SR34.5 billion, accounting for 21.7 percent of the total. **media[2780337]*
